text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years I spent with Buena 
Vista—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back brings a sense of 
nostalgia... and they truly were dear, 
precious days.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: "Big Brother! Let's go train, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: "Big sis! Let's go training, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista was so attached to me, acting 
spoiled like a real younger sister... I 
remember how utterly adorable she was.
choice_data_list:
(Being called big brother... it makes me 
so happy)

(Being called big sister... it makes me so 
happy)

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Onii-chan... wake up! 
Wakey-waaaakey~~?"
choice_data_list:
Hey now... Buena, don't climb on top of 
me...

Hey now... Buena, please don't climb on 
top of me...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Onee-chan... wake up! 
Wakey-waaaakey~~?"
choice_data_list:
Hey now... Buena, don't climb on top of 
me...

Hey now... Buena, please don't climb on 
top of me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —I'm not riding it anymore, you know?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, you're finally awake.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I felt bad about interrupting, but... it's 
almost time for my tandem run with 
Desire-chan.
choice_data_list: Is it really that time already...?
Is it really that time already...?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you were fast asleep, weren't you? I 
wonder what kind of dream you were having.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why you meant "don't ride"? 
You really were such a spoiled baby, 
weren't you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I won't do it anymore, so don't 
worry! Come on, let's go, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to nod, I remembered. 
If her voice in my dream was linked to 
reality, then the voice calling me "big 
brother" back then was...
choice_data_list:
(...No, I guess it was just a voice from a 
dream after all)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to nod, I remembered. 
If her voice in my dream was linked to 
reality, then the voice calling me "big 
sister" back then was...
choice_data_list:
(...No, I guess it was just a voice from a 
dream after all)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I've been expecting you, Buena-san.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To me, you remain my greatest trial. I am 
grateful... to be able to chase your back 
as you ascend to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Desire-chan. You are a precious 
presence to me as well!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Beyond our fierce competition lies a 
breathtaking view... Let's go see it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Challenge accepted.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Can't just take it lying down, ya know? 
Mind giving me a shot at payback?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Yes, of course! Shall we all do a 
mock race together too?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks lively over there. ...Guess I 
gotta give it my all here too~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Float like a butterfly... sting like a 
bee... Hmph! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Looks like Buena-san is going to do a 
mock race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Do your best, Buena-saaan!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm gonna go run with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes! Watch me from the front row!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by uniquely charming Umamusume 
who share the same era... Buena Vista 
shines brilliantly again today.
